name: Jukuzuma Toushi Claudia Chijoku no Rinkan Kyousei Chitsunai Shasei
original_name: 熟妻闘士クラウディア　恥辱の輪姦強制膣内射精
source:
Claudia, a former gladiator, throws her body into the underground fighting arena in order to get information about her husband Lukius, who was known as the invincible gladiator.
As a condition for the cooperation of Albino, the owner of the underground fighting arena, Claudia must 'win' while wearing special armor. She then heads alone into the arena to get that information. However, the underground arena is caught up in a storm of sexual desire and big breasted gladiator Claudia is attacked, violated, and humiliated!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE039209.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
前剑斗士克劳迪娅为了打听丈夫卢基乌斯的下落，只身投入地下斗技场。她的丈夫曾被誉为战无不胜的剑斗士。
斗技场主人阿尔比诺答应提供协助，条件是克劳迪娅必须穿上他交给自己的特殊铠甲并取得“胜利”。为了获得情报，她独自走进赛场。然而，地下斗技场里欲望翻涌，巨乳剑斗士克劳迪娅即将遭受袭击、侵犯与凌辱！
